relevance.title: Professional relevance
relevance.body: How well this person matches the preferred requirements of the Pit Call — sub-role and seniority, skills, languages, education and experience. It is independent from date coverage: a 100% relevant person can still cover only part of your dates.

partial_coverage.title: Partial coverage
partial_coverage.body: Full and Partial describe date coverage only. For a single block, a Partial covers at least half of the requested days; for a full season, no more than 20% may be missing. My Pool members follow the Pool coverage rule. Professional relevance is separate.

stale_calendar.title: Calendar freshness
stale_calendar.body: Availability that has not been confirmed for a while stops being used for matching, so teams only see dates you have recently stood behind. Confirming refreshes every open day at once.

expand_outside_pool.title: Search outside My Pool
expand_outside_pool.body: This Pit Call was published to your Pool only. Expanding it also searches freelancers outside your Pool. It uses the token amount shown on the button, charged once.

unlock_details.title: Unlock details
unlock_details.body: Opens the candidate’s full professional profile: skills, seniority, languages, experience, day rate and travel. For candidates outside My Pool, identity and contacts stay protected until the confirmation lifecycle allows them. A My Pool member’s name may already be visible; contacts are still shared only after confirmation. The button shows the exact cost, including when it is free.

request_confirmation.title: Request confirmation
request_confirmation.body: Sends this freelancer a binding confirmation request. If they accept, the Pit Call is closed, other pending proposals are cancelled and contacts are exchanged.

confirm_match.title: Confirm
confirm_match.body: Accepts the job. The engagement becomes confirmed, those days are blocked in your calendar and contacts are exchanged with the team.

ask_more_time.title: Ask for more time
ask_more_time.body: Pushes back the deadline of this request so you can decide later. It is available only close to the deadline, a limited number of times, and never past the start of the Pit Call.

decline_match.title: Decline
decline_match.body: Turns down this request. The team can propose the job to someone else and your days stay free.

cancel_late.title: Cancel after the grace window
cancel_late.body: The grace window has passed, so this counts as a late cancellation: the engagement is cancelled, the team is notified, and those days stay blocked in your calendar — you cannot make them available or take another job on them.

confirm_calendar.title: Confirm availability
confirm_calendar.body: Tells us your open days are still accurate and refreshes your calendar freshness, so your availability keeps being used for matching.
